body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZx1yZXiTrFXKbSdFZ

Part of #27377 (wave 4, Tier 1 live legs, card W4-L1)

Selector `release-18.3.0-w4-l1`: the live legs of the 40 Tier 1 items in access-security, ai, api-backend, approvals, attachments-storage, automation and cli whose pins record #28929 (W4-C2a, same subject) left a clause `partial`, `skipped` or `blocked`. Release-candidate rerun (SKILL §5 trigger 1), approved by the maintainer on 2026-11-02 07:06Z. Every item has a verdict: **37 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN**. No item is `planned`.

**Coverage mode: this card drove the live legs, not the pins.** Its targets were the 137 clauses #28929 scored below `pass` (88 partial, 43 skipped, 6 blocked). Each was judged live on a booted stack (HTTP, CLI or browser, as the clause asks). The 63 clauses #28929 scored `pass` keep that verdict and were not re-run. Item verdict = the #28929 verdicts plus the live verdicts here (RUNNER.md "Verdicts"). Of the 137 targets: **125 pass, 6 fail, 6 blocked, 0 skipped**.

## Environment fingerprint

- Subject: framework `7fa9873f38f7a0158e3ce17338dcc0f446b113e3` (detached, never followed main or the Version PR #26517). `ui/` is in the same tree; the console was built from it.
- Build: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (37 s), `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2`: 118/118 tasks, 0 cached, 17m21s; `pnpm console:build`: 72/72 (71 cached), `packages/console/dist` ready. `check-dev-prereqs`: 106 package artifacts present.
- Node 22, pnpm 10.31.0, Playwright chromium from `/opt/pw-browsers`. 4 CPUs, ~15 GB. This container holds one address, 192.0.2.2 (TEST-NET-1).
- Boots: every boot ran from a scratch copy of `examples/app-showcase` (tar copy, `node_modules` symlinked) so no install, upload or datasource file escaped into the shared tree, with its own port (41611–41674) and file DB:
  `OS_PORT=P OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=… OS_HOME=… setsid node packages/cli/bin/run.js dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p P -d file:…/data.db`.
  Variants: a walled `group` boot (OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group, OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai, OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only; /auth/config read tenancyPosture "group"); scheduled work on (OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1) beside a default boot; SIGTERM then cold boot over the same DB for the restart legs; OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED=false; four MCP OAuth host boots (unheld 10.0.0.5, held 192.0.2.2 with and without OS_ALLOW_INSECURE_OAUTH_HTTP, https via `--cert/--key`); a wall-clock offset shim for the SLA leg; `NODE_ENV=production os serve` for the automigrate warning; a local verdaccio 6.11.1 carrying the subject's 74 packed `@objectstack/*` packages for the scaffold's pre-release leg.
- Browser legs: the boot's own `/_console`, form sign-in (cookie + bearer), at most three Chromium sessions at once card-wide.
- Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai), the showcase demo personas, and members minted by admin create-user + change-password; runtime fixtures in scratch packages are named in their rows.
- Times: 2026-11-02 07:13Z (checkout) to 07:59Z (last verdict).
- Execution: the card session built the tree and dispatched seven runner subagents (effort high, one area group each, own ports and DBs); it checked each runner's evidence against its rows before writing this record.

- **approvals** (4): act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate r5, email-action-token-door r10, request-page-reply-and-reader-visibility r5, status-mirror-field r6
- **attachments-storage** (9): attach-requires-parent-edit r9, download-authz-both-sides r10, inline-grid-receipt-cells r5, orphan-tombstone-reap r4, presigned-upload-roundtrip r3, read-inherits-parent-rls r9, sys-file-status-pipeline r5, upload-limits-scope-and-ownership r4, upload-session-abort r8

## Reproduction rules

### 1. automation.setup-packaged-automation-board · A0, A1, A2, A3, A5, A6 · FAIL (stale spec)

The item still describes the Setup › Packaged automation page whose flows half #28785 retired (merged 2026-11-01; ADR-0146 D11 retires the page's flows half, D4 moves the flow switch to the Studio Automations pillar and clone to Studio's New similar).

1. Boot the stock showcase; sign in as admin. `GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=setup`.
   - Expected (A0): group_apps holds `{id: nav_packaged_automation, type: component, componentRef: automation:packaged}`.
   - Actual: it holds `{id: nav_packaged_actions, componentRef: automation:packaged-actions, label: Packaged Actions}`; `nav_packaged_automation` occurs 0 times.
2. Open the Setup sidebar in the console. It shows "Packaged Actions" and no "Packaged Automation"; the link lands on `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/component/automation/packaged-actions` (heading "Packaged actions"), which lists no `packaged-flow-*` rows, no flow switch and no flow Clone (A1, A2, A3's flow half, A5's toggle cells, A6).
3. Type `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/component/automation/packaged`: it redirects to `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/flow?package=com.example.showcase`.
- The replacement surfaces, measured live: Studio `auto-ledger-switch` toggles a flow and the state persists across a reload and in the activation row (what A2 asks); Studio `auto-new-similar-*` opens the dialog A6 asks for, validates name and label, and shows the 400 sentence in `role=alert`; the Studio rail and `GET /api/v1/automation/_status` both list 32 flows (A1); the Packaged actions page carries the actions half with no clone (A3); a 409 on the switch shows verbatim in Studio's refusal strip, which has no `role=alert` (A5). A4 and A7 pass live.
- Reproduced twice: two browser runs of the Setup nav and page and two of the Studio replacement, each on a fresh form sign-in, plus two API reads of the nav. Self-check: testid/role targeting, screenshot before DOM reads, member cells in their own context with get-session confirming the identity, console built from this tree (the redirect matches `ui/` at the subject).
- Disposition: **stale spec**. The re-point is already carried by #28579 (open, ADR-0146 rollout N-29), whose list names this item; no new card.

## Derived item verdicts

- **PASS (37):** every item not listed below.
- **PARTIAL (2):**
  - api-backend.action-activation-door-contract: A4 `blocked(fixture, knownGaps[3])`. The metadata-plane 503 arm fires only when `resolveRouteActionDeclaration` catches a throw from the metadata plane, and no stock request reaches it; the 404 and zero-ledger-row halves of A4 held live.
  - approvals.email-action-token-door: A0, A1, A3, A4, A5 `blocked(fixture, knownGaps[0])`. Re-confirmed at the subject: `issueActionTokens` has no production caller, so no approver email or notification mints an action token. The live at-rest reminder read and the dead-link page held.
- **FAIL (1):** automation.setup-packaged-automation-board (stale spec, rule 1 above).

## Delta against the pins record (#28929, same subject)

- PARTIAL→PASS: **37**. PARTIAL→PARTIAL: 2 (the two above). PARTIAL→FAIL: 1 (setup-packaged-automation-board: #28929 recorded five clauses `blocked(dependency, #28785)`; driven live, the retired surface is measured and the clauses fail as stale spec).

## Delta against wave 3 (#27409, at c4c515ad)

- PASS→PASS: 29 · PARTIAL→PASS: 9 · PARTIAL→PARTIAL: 2 · PARTIAL→FAIL: 1 · PASS→FAIL: 0 · PASS→PARTIAL: 0.
- **PARTIAL→PASS (9):** ai.mcp-oauth-private-host-transport (r6 stages A0 with an unheld literal), approvals.status-mirror-field (SLA cascade driven with a clock shim), approvals.request-page-reply-and-reader-visibility (reader grant and the reader flag staged live in a scratch package), attachments-storage.read-inherits-parent-rls (bounded probe reached with a >2000-row federated object), attachments-storage.sys-file-status-pipeline, attachments-storage.orphan-tombstone-reap and attachments-storage.upload-session-abort (failure legs staged live: behind-hook insert, EISDIR byte path, immutable parts dir, removed part file), automation.paused-run-trigger-record-masked (runtime object with an `internal: true` field and a member persona).
- **PARTIAL→PARTIAL (2):** api-backend.action-activation-door-contract and approvals.email-action-token-door, same gaps as wave 3.
- **PARTIAL→FAIL (1):** automation.setup-packaged-automation-board. Wave 3 judged the page before #28785 retired it; this is the retirement, not a regression.

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 40 agent-minutes in all, after the clauses had verdicts, on the same boots and personas (admin, demo personas, minted members, auditor, anonymous; walled org admin and members).
- access-security (~6 min): security/explain with unknown/empty ids and cross-user callers; FLS filter/orderby/fields on masked keys; /me trio with empty `userId=`, trailing slash, garbage bearer; walled grant-table writes naming another org, unknown or empty user and set ids; share-link tokens (empty, whitespace, suffixed, upper-cased), ineligible records, unknown audiences, another member's links. **Finding:** a share link's `redactFields` accepts a field the object does not have (extracted).
- ai (~5 min): MCP tools with missing, unknown, empty and wrong-typed arguments as admin, auditor, anonymous and a bogus key; prompts/get; /mcp/skill variants. **Finding:** a malformed `params` answers JSON-RPC -32603 "Internal error" carrying a raw Zod issue array instead of -32602 (extracted).
- api-backend + approvals (~6 min): createMany/updateMany/deleteMany boundary payloads, owner spoofing, /batch unknown ops; the act page with dead token shapes; reply door; activation door shapes. **Finding:** `deleteMany {"ids":[""]}` refuses with the sentence "requires 'ids' to be an array" and an empty `fields[]` (extracted).
- attachments-storage (~5 min): unknown/empty ids on every storage door, presign size/name edges, oversize PUT then complete, acl flips by non-owners, admin completing a member's upload. No finding.
- automation API (~4 min): run reads and resume by readers outside the scope, unknown and mismatched run/flow names, runs `limit` boundary, hook door bodies and clock skew. No finding.
- automation browser/CLI (~9 min): screen and resume doors with unknown runs, extra keys, blank values, terminal runs, cross-flow names, member and anonymous; PUT /meta/flow name mismatch, bad names, empty body. **Findings:** a text field stores an object or array as its JSON text (extracted); Studio's refusal strip has no `role=alert`, so a refused flow switch is not announced (extracted).
- cli (~5 min): invalid autoMigrate values, empty verify families, invalid scaffold names, a non-empty current directory, `migrate meta --stored` over an absent database. **Findings:** a current-directory scaffold overwrites the user's existing files (extracted); `os migrate meta --stored --json` over an absent database answers `clean: true` (added to #28947, same class, different door).
- No security finding.

## Time: environment prep vs testing

- Environment prep: checkout + install + full build + console build 07:13Z–07:33Z (about 20 min wall), plus about 35 agent-minutes of per-runner scratch copies, boots, personas and fixtures (incl. ~6 min verdaccio pre-release registry).
- Testing: seven runners 07:33Z–07:59Z (26 min wall), about 75 agent-minutes of clause driving plus about 40 of probes.
- Ratio about 1 to 2. Wall clock to the last verdict about 46 min.

## Per-clause verdicts

One row per TARGET clause (the clauses #28929 left below `pass`), with the layer and one line of text evidence. The tables are in the two comments below. The #28929 `pass` rows are not repeated.

Checklist-accuracy findings, fixture gaps and pin-promotion candidates from this run are parked on #27377 (anchor comment), not extracted.
